NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 10:22 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 24.5 DraftKings points for $8,400, at Las Vegas. Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.8, $7,800) and Ja'Marr Chase (17.0, $8,100) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.91 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 10:22 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 7

Puka Nacua, LAR at LV ($8,400)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 24.5 DraftKings points at $8,400, the 2nd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.7 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 11.5 targets on 33.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.91 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 24.4 points with a simulated floor of 11.9 and a ceiling of 45.2, and he holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs GB ($7,800)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 34.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.41 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 38.0, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 27.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Ja'Marr Chase, CIN at BAL ($8,100)

Ja'Marr Chase projects 3rd at the position with 17.0 DraftKings points at $8,100. The model gives him 8.1 targets on 33.7 routes. The salary works out to 2.10 projected points per $1,000, 17th of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Chase averaged 17.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 37.3, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against Baltimore, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Matthew Golden, GB at DET ($6,000)

Matthew Golden projects for 15.9 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 2.65 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 27 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 8.0 targets on 32.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Golden averaged 15.8 points with a simulated floor of 4.7 and a ceiling of 35.3, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 3-point underdog on the road against Detroit, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.
